mapper.select: SELECT document_id, user_id, permission, enabled, create_time, update_time FROM biz_document_user WHERE document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY user_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_document_user (document_id, user_id, permission, enabled) SELECT #{mapping.documentId}, #{mapping.userId}, #{mapping.permission}, #{mapping.enabled} FROM biz_document WHERE id = #{mapping.documentId} AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND deleted = 0 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE permission = VALUES(permission), enabled = VALUES(enabled), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
